name: _schema
title: Columns of the NEAR public tables

name: q00_signer_day
title: Helper table - one row per signing account per day, 1 Jan to 9 Nov 2026
sentence: Built once from the public NEAR transactions table so every account chart reads this small table instead of rescanning the chain.

name: q10_daily_signers_by_segment
title: Daily signing accounts by segment, Jan-Nov 2026
sentence: Most daily NEAR signers are HOT game accounts; the "organic" line counts accounts that sent at least one transaction to something other than the game or themselves, excluding the kaiching self-transaction factory.

name: q11_real_active_weekly
title: Weekly "real active accounts" under four stricter definitions
sentence: Each step down removes more accounts that look automated or one-off; the bottom line (engaged and returning) is our most conservative count of real users.

name: q12_retention_cohorts
title: Weekly retention of organic accounts by first-seen week
sentence: Of the accounts first seen doing something other than the HOT game in a given week, this shows how many came back in later weeks.

name: q20_oct27_senders
title: 27 Oct event - who sent to the unnamed address, and what they sent
sentence: Breaks down the one-off transactions sent to address 282acb...47ef on 26-28 Oct by type of sending account, action and NEAR attached.

name: q21_oct27_target_balance
title: 27 Oct event - daily balance of the unnamed address, 20 Oct to 9 Nov
sentence: Shows how much NEAR the address collected on 27 Oct and whether it was moved out afterwards.

name: q22_oct27_funders
title: 27 Oct event - who first funded the 12,028 sending accounts
sentence: If one account funded most of the senders, the event was one operator's campaign rather than 12,028 independent users.

name: q23_hex_signers_new_vs_returning
title: Organic implicit (64-hex) signers per day - new vs returning, 1 Oct to 9 Nov
sentence: Tests whether the 3 Nov rise in unnamed-account signers came from brand-new accounts or from existing ones waking up.

name: q24_nov3_hex_top_receivers
title: 3 Nov event - which contracts the unnamed (64-hex) signers used, 30 Oct to 6 Nov
sentence: Lists the top contracts called by new and returning unnamed accounts each day around 3 Nov.

name: q25_nov3_new_hex_funders
title: 3 Nov event - who funded the unnamed accounts first seen on 2-4 Nov
sentence: If a few funders created most new unnamed accounts, the 3 Nov rise was a campaign or a product launch, not broad organic growth.

name: q26_game_methods_daily
title: HOT game (game.hot.tg) calls by method on seven sample days, 7 Jul to 1 Oct
sentence: Shows which game action fell as daily game signers dropped from about 101k (7 Jul) to about 40k (15 Sep).

name: q30_buyback_balance_daily
title: Buyback wallet (buybacks.multisignature.near) - daily NEAR balance, inflows and outflows 1 Jul to 9 Nov 2026
sentence: If bought-back NEAR were burned or sold, the balance would fall; a balance that only rises means the NEAR is being held.

name: q32_buyback_counterparties
title: Buyback wallet - who sends to it and who it sends to, weekly, 1 Sep to 9 Nov
sentence: Names the accounts on the other side of the buyback wallet's receipts, showing where its NEAR comes from and where any of it goes.

name: q27_oct27_senders_history
title: 27 Oct event - what the 12,028 sending accounts did earlier in 2026
sentence: Shows when the accounts that swept NEAR to one address on 27 Oct were last active, and whether they were HOT game accounts, before going quiet.

name: q28_oct27_target_outflows
title: 27 Oct event - where the unnamed address sent its NEAR, 20 Oct to 31 Oct
sentence: Names the accounts that received NEAR from address 282acb...47ef, including the 78,677 NEAR it moved out on 29 Oct.

name: q33_buyback_sep09_moves
title: Buyback wallet - every balance change on 9 Sep 2026, the day it gained about 515k NEAR
sentence: Lists the transactions behind the one-off jump in the buyback wallet so anyone can look them up on an explorer.

name: q29_self_only_bursts
title: Who made the self-transaction bursts (Feb 2026, 2-3 Oct, 3 Nov)
sentence: Groups accounts that only sent transactions to themselves by account family, to show these bursts come from a few account factories, not from users.
